import json
d = json.load(open('/private/tmp/vista-task002-local-3x3-20260822-05/formal-task002-local-3x3-minimaxm3-20260822-05-native-replicate-01/workspace/DATA/products/CoachForce.json'))

# Check ALL PRs for "market_research" or "mrr" mentions
for pr in d.get('prs', []):
    title = pr.get('title', '')
    summary = pr.get('summary', '')
    link = pr.get('link', '')
    if 'market_research' in link.lower() or 'cofoaix_market' in link.lower() or 'mrr' in title.lower():
        print(f'PR #{pr.get("number")}: {title}')
        print(f'  summary: {summary[:200]}')
        print(f'  link: {link}')
        print(f'  author: {pr.get("user", {}).get("login")}')
        # Reviews
        for r in pr.get('reviews', []):
            print(f'  review by {r.get("user", {}).get("login")}: {r.get("state")}')
        print()
